newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat gold j/v said operational.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat gold j/v said operational.

text.p: Ballarat Goldfields NL said on Thursday its Ballarat Gold Project joint venture in Victoria with the Rothschild Group was now operational and contracts had been let for exploration and underground development.

Under the agreement, Rothschild, subsidiaries of merchant bank Rothschild Australia Ltd, would contribute A$7.3 million to the project, including A$3.6 million of equity from a proposed placement of 45 million Ballarat shares at 8.0 cents each.
The placement would give Rothschild a 15.4 percent stake in Ballarat, subject to approval by shareholders on March 19, Ballarat said in a statement.
Under the joint venture agreement, Ballarat will hold 75 percent of the Ballarat Gold Project and Rothschild 25 percent, the company said.

"We now have sufficient funding in place and the technical and financial backing of our partner, the Rothschild Group, to continue working towards our vision of developing a significant underground mining operation in Ballarat," Ballarat's chief executive officer Andrew Woskett said.

Ballarat said it will receive more than 90 percent project revenue from about the initial A$24 million of metal sales, after which sales revenue will be distributed according to the respective participating interests.

In April 2003, Rothschild may elect to dismantle the joint venture by exercising a put option, whereupon 100 percent ownership of the Ballarat Gold Project would revert to Ballarat Goldfields, it said.
